name: Vatta (Hungary)
description: White field charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Vatta: a blue and green shield with ears of grain, with a helm, an arm-and-hammer crest and red and grey mantling, above a scroll inscribed VATTA.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Vatta arms with helm, crest, mantling and scroll
